name: Will removing my tub actually make the bathroom easier to use?

mainEntity.name: Will removing my tub actually make the bathroom easier to use?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Replacing the tub with a shower usually improves access and may make the room feel more open, but the result depends on entry width, enclosure design, lighting, storage, floor transitions, and how the shower is used. Simply removing the tub does not guarantee an easy-to-clean or comfortable space.

Key factors:
- Choose a door or curtain arrangement that preserves usable clearance.
- Plan a niche or shelving before waterproofing and wall finishes.
- Consider handheld controls and a seat based on user needs.
- Coordinate lighting, ventilation, and mirror placement with the new layout.

Describe your daily frustrations to Elite Remodeling & Design, not just the desired appearance. The design can then prioritize access, storage, cleaning, and visual openness together.
